import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    iT = 1.0/T
    num = p[0] + p[1]*iT + (p[2] + p[3]*iT)*eps
    den = 1 + p[4]*eps + (p[5]*iT + p[6]*T)*eps + p[7]*eps**2
    return -eps*num/den*np.exp(-(p[8] + p[9]*iT)*eps)
